title: Shimon Sikhni of Utzah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Kohelet Rabbah chapter 4, he tells Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, “I am as great as you,” for he dug wells and cisterns in Jerusalem. Yochanan applied to him the verse, “Drawing near to listen is better than the sacrifice of fools,” etc.

notes.text: The consulted Kohelet paragraph identifies Shimon as the digger and Yochanan as the person applying the verse. It spells the place Eitzah; the supplied notice’s Utzah form is retained without equating locations.
Kohelet Rabbah 4:17 identifies Shimon as the digger and Yochanan as the one applying the verse. It spells the place Eitzah, beside Hyman’s Utzah.
